settings.cta_subtitle: Every frame in this gallery was clicked on a real TrekToShikhar batch. Join our upcoming Shimla or Dehradun departures and bring home stories that last a lifetime.

photos.title: Kedarkantha Dawn Summit Panorama
photos.details: Captured moments after our 3:00 AM alpine push from Hargaon Base. At -7°C, the entire Garhwal skyline ignited in molten gold across Swargarohini, Black Peak, and Gangotri.

photos.title: Final Ridge Push in Knee-Deep Snow
photos.details: Our strict 14-trekker Shikharite batch moving in calm single-file rhythm with microspikes and gaiters. Clear skies, crunchy fresh powder, and unstoppable team spirit.

photos.title: Milky Way Over Juda Ka Talab
photos.details: After hot mountain soup and stories around camp, the frozen pine-ringed lake reflected millions of winter stars with zero light pollution.

photos.title: Nag Tibba Flag Crest & Garhwal Wall
photos.details: Standing at the Serpent's Peak summit with fluttering Tibetan prayer flags and an unobstructed 360-degree view of Bandarpoonch and Kedarnath domes.

photos.title: Nag Tibba Base Camp Twilight Tents
photos.details: Freshly pitched 4-season waterproof dome tents nestled amidst ancient oak canopies just as hot ginger-lemon tea and pakoras were served to our weekend batch.

photos.title: Sunbeams Through Dense Oak Canopy
photos.details: Morning rays piercing moss-covered oak and rhododendron forests during Day 1 ascent. Ideal cool shade and gentle gradients for first-time Himalayan trekkers.

photos.title: Shimla Alpine Valley Pastel Sunrise
photos.details: Looking across the serene Narkanda valleys and Greater Himalayan snow line from the ancient wooden Hatu Mata sanctuary ridge.

photos.title: Snow-Dusted Deodar Ridge Walk
photos.details: Crisp winter air, untouched white deodar boughs, and dramatic cloud inversions drifting beneath our boots along the Shimla alpine trail.

photos.title: Sea of Clouds Below Narkanda Crest
photos.details: Post-monsoon clarity created a surreal ocean of valley clouds right beneath the ridge as our group paused for trail snacks and group portraits.

photos.title: Churdhar Peak Dramatic Silhouette
photos.details: The highest peak of the Outer Himalayas standing tall above glacial boulder fields and sacred wildlife sanctuary ridges.

photos.title: Sacred Deodar Trail Into Wilderness
photos.details: Walking deep inside Churdhar Wildlife Sanctuary where ancient cedar trees give way to sweeping high-altitude meadows and wild Himalayan herbs.

photos.title: Trishul & Nanda Ghunti From Brahmatal
photos.details: Face-to-face with the towering 7,000-meter giants Mt. Trishul and Nanda Ghunti gleaming under cobalt winter skies after a fresh overnight snowfall.

photos.title: Sub-Zero Alpine Tent Life at Bekaltal
photos.details: Inside -10°C rated thermal sleeping bags with evening oximeter checks complete — cozy warmth and laughter echoing across the silent snow meadow.

photos.title: Valley of Gods River Crossing Panorama
photos.details: Glacial turquoise Supin river winding past centuries-old wooden Himalayan villages on the iconic Har Ki Dun valley approach.

photos.title: Once a Shikharite, Always a Shikharite
photos.details: Strangers who met at Dehradun station five days earlier celebrating together above the clouds — proving that the best part of every trail is the family you find.
